title: NFL Lab · Data Engineering
description: Warehouse storage, freshness, pipeline runs, benchmarks and query durations. Real measurements only: values come from lab_monitoring.sqlite (written by `python -m nflbdb.lab.build`) and the Superset metadata DB.

options.content: **Engineering monitor.** Snapshot tables are refreshed each time `python -m nflbdb.lab.build` runs (no live agent). Step history comes from `reports/tables/pipeline_run_log`; ages are measured *at export time*. Query-duration panels read Superset's own logs. Panels stay empty rather than showing placeholder values.

panels.title: Superset request durations (from Superset logs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT dttm AS "time", action AS metric, duration_ms FROM logs WHERE $__timeFilter(dttm) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND (action ILIKE '%data%' OR action ILIKE '%explore_json%' OR action ILIKE '%sql_json%') ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Durations Superset logs for chart-data / SQL Lab requests. If empty, list the logged actions with: SELECT action, count(*) FROM logs GROUP BY 1.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(start_time / 1000.0) AS started, round((end_time - start_time)::numeric, 0) AS duration_ms, status, rows, left(sql, 120) AS sql FROM query WHERE start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(start_time / 1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 100
